declaration-property-value-disallowed-li.message: No hex fallback in var(): every design token is defined in styles.css, and a fallback only hides a renamed or missing token (FE-MOD-01, ui-design-system.md).

media-feature-name-value-allowed-list.message: Breakpoints are only 768px, 1024px and 1440px, the device classes of REQ-UI-009 (DS-11). A component that has to react to its own width uses a container query.
